title: Don't hit panic button during wild market swings: Credit Suisse's Mandy Xu
description: Mandy Xu from Credit Suisse on market volatility and how investors should respond. With CNBC's Brian Sullivan and the Fast Money traders, Tim Seymour, Chris Mills, Karen Finerman and Brian Kelly. asr.full_text: Your next guest says her clients panicking and they're looking to the Federal Reserve, maybe to help keep a floor under this market, but with more coronavirus cases every day and the real threat of a major economic slowdown ahead. How optimistic can you be really right now? Joining us as Mandy is Chief Equity Derivative Strategist at Credit Suisse. Mandy welcome. No panic. Good. What are you advising though, your clients to do? So I think what surprised a lot of people is that despite measures of volatility reaching post-crisis highs, if you just take a look at the VIX index, other measures in the option market are actually signaling, I wouldn't say calm, but certainly no panic. And that's backed up by the flow that we're seeing from institutional clients where what we see. What we're seeing from institutional clients, they are monetizing hedges, but they are not panic, grabbing for new hedges, and that to me is a constructive sign. Can you explain what that meant? Are they roleing out things that are working? WISF, WE HAVE TO START GIVING BASKETBALL A REFINAL. I DON'T WANT YOU TO HEAR ME SINCE YOU CALL ME WALKEE. I DON'T WANT YOU TO HEAR ME SINCE YOU CALL ME WALKEE. IT FEEL LIKE WE ARE ALL HELPING VIEWERS UNDERSTAND THERE'S A LOT OF STUFF THAT GOES ON IN THE MARKET, TAKE. THIS IS THE MECHANICS OF THE STUFF THE PROS LIKE YOU DEAL WITH EVERY DAY. MONETIZATION MEANS THEY ARE EXISTING HEDGE. WE ARE SEEING SOME OF THAT, BUT THE MAJORITY IS RESETTING HEADGES. MAINTAINING THE SAME EXPOSURE THE MARKET MOVED, BUT BASICALLY IT IS ROLLING THE STRIKES FORWARD. AND IT IS TERMS OF SECTORS, YOU SEE THEM GOING AFTER CERTAIN AND MASSAT IS JUST HIGHER BECAUSE OF THE MARKET CHANGE. IT IS ONE SHORTLY INCREASING SHORT ON THE MARKET MOVE. WE OBVIOUSLY KNOW SECTORS THAT HAVE BEEN THE BIG LAGGERS. I THINK PART OF THE REASON WHY INSTITUTIONAL RECESSIONS HAVE ACTUALLY HELD UP OK SO FAR THIS YEAR IS A LOT OF THEM, SINCE BEEN THE VICE PRESIDENT IN THE NEAR TERM AND THOSE SHORTS HAVE BEEN CONCENTRATED IN THE VALUE AND CYCLICAL SECTORS, WHAT ARE THEY? ENERGY, FINANCIALS? FUSSYALS, YES. THE OBVIOUSLY HAVE SOLD OUT MORE AND THAT HAS HELPED Out INVESTORS IN TERMS OF PERFORMANCE. WE RARELY SEE THE VIX HANG AROUND 40 FOR EVEN DAYS, RIGHT? SO WHERE DO YOU THINK IT'S GOING? I THINK IN THE NEAR TERM WE ARE LIKELY TO SEE CONTINUED LITERALLY INCREASED. GIVEN THIS MACRO CONDITION. ONE POINT I WOULD LIKE TO MAKE, EVEN THOUGH IT IS VERY, VERY ELEVATED AT 40-PLUS, IT IS ACTUALLY TRADING BELOW WHAT THE MARKET IS REALIZING, SO VIX HIGHS IN THE NEXT THREE YEARS. VIX AT $40-$50 AND ABOUT 3%. WE ARE TAKING 4-5% DAILY MOVES IN THE NEXT TWO WEEKS. WE ARE TRICKING FROM THE OPTION MARKET. POSITIVE TRACKING HERE. BIDEN HAS DEPENDS ON THE OPTION MARKET. STORES ARE STILL HANGING HOSTED WERE THE HOLDINGS, THE FED'S PRICING WAS 75. WERE SELLING COURT HOLDINGS AND SHIFTING TO CASH, giving the macro environment, but the holding on to their core longs, selectively adding in certain situations. But certainly, you know, this to us is more constructive than what we saw in the fourth quarter of 2018. All right. Mandi Zu of Credit Suisse, good stuff, Mandy. Thank you very much. BK, I mean, you bought puts, it sounds like Mandi's clients, what they're positioning goes into your trade. Yeah, I think, I think so. I mean, it doesn't, today didn't feel like this was the bottom. I think there's just so much uncertainty out there that continues. OF A DIFFERENT SITUATION? IS THIS HOW WE WANT TO DEAL WITH IT? I THINK SO. TODAY DIDN'T FEEL LIKE THIS WAS THE BOTTOM. I THINK THERE IS SO MUCH UNCERTAINTY OUT THERE THAT CONTINUES. WE HAVE SEVERAL MORE WEEKS OF THIS BEFORE WE GET SOME KIND OF CLARITY. WE HAVE GOTTEN HIT ON TWO FRONTS. IT IS NOT JUST THE VIRUS HEADLINES BUT IT IS THE OIL HEADLINE THAT YOU TALKED ABOUT A LITTLE MORE LIGHT ON THIS. IT'S THE SUCCESS INFLATION YOU TALKED ABOUT LAST NIGHT. Thanks for watching!
